text.tspan: neutral runs straight through: not switched, not fused
Non-isolated block (rev. E): bidirectional AC chopper, 120 V <-> 277 V / 230 V, 10 kW continuous, 20 kW for 10 s, no contactors
Controller (MCU): PWM 50 to about 110 kHz (rises at light load for zero-voltage switching), polarity-based commutation, ratio select 277 V / 230 V, current limit, protection
Inputs: V_HV, V_LV, CS1, CS2, neutral-loss detection, NTC on each switch group, L1 and heatsink Telemetry: isolated CAN FD + Ethernet (V, I, T, P, Q, energy, state, faults)
